entries.title: Per Aspera
entries.definitive_edition: Per Aspera Ad Astra Edition plus free DLC on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with current storefront build and DLC.

primary.version: Ad Astra Edition / current Windows PC build with Blue Mars and free DLC
primary.why: Per Aspera is a planet-scale Mars terraforming/base-building simulation released for Windows on December 3, 2020. The base game has official Windows add-ons including Green Mars, Blue Mars, Home, and the Ad Astra Edition; the Ad Astra bundle includes the base game and Blue Mars, while Green Mars and other add-ons remain available separately. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it is the original release platform and gives the cleanest settings, capture, Workshop, and co-op-capable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release with Blue Mars plus the free Green Mars, Home, and Buildings Paint Pack add-ons installed. Use the Ad Astra Edition if buying fresh, then confirm the free DLC has been claimed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster split was found. Treat Blue Mars as paid content and Green Mars/Home/Buildings Paint Pack as add-ons to claim for completeness.
